title: Finite-level component of the scalar root abelian transpose
statement: In the setting of [def-sp-tower-class-pullback], [def-sp-tower-class-systems], and [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], let chi satisfy the section identity from [lem-sp-tower-restricted-scalar-adjunction], let d satisfy the integral root comparison of [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback], and let theta1 be normalized LinePullback data. At every finite level n, every pro-etale chart U, and every section x of the forgotten root module on Y, the component of the scalar/geometric adjunct of theta1.hom followed by chi applied to x equals the component of the abelian adjunct of d.forgetIso followed by the target scalar adjunct of d.rootIso.hom applied to x.

source.place: Paragraph (2), finite-level evaluation of the abelian transpose before assembling the tower map

proof.text: Evaluate the scalar unit, the normalized line evaluation, the root restriction and the section identity of chi at (n,U). The first Kummer square and the equality of the middle component with unitsPull identify the root term with restriction of the root section. The two evaluated additive morphisms therefore have the same value on x.
